classes.AGREE_APPROVED: both admit the entry and size it identically (1e-6 USDT)
classes.AGREE_REFUSED_SAME_RULE: both refuse and the mapped rule is the one that fired
classes.PARITY_DEFECT: the research budget admits an entry the runtime refuses under a rule BOTH implement, or the captured decision is not reproduced from its own state
classes.RESEARCH_ONLY_REFUSAL: the research budget refuses where the runtime admits; the research side is stricter (a floor/cap convention or a cooldown that outlives the streak)
classes.RULE_NOT_MODELLED_BY_RESEARCH: the runtime refuses under a rule the research budget does not implement; a live run is therefore at least as strict as the reading
classes.RULE_ORDER_DIFFERS: both refuse, but each engine names a different rule because their check order differs; the entry is refused either way
classes.SIZING_DIFFERS: both admit the entry and size it differently by MORE than the runtime's own cent rounding (1e-6 USDT is the arithmetic tolerance; anything above 0.005 USDT is a policy difference)
classes.SIZING_ROUNDING_ONLY: both admit the entry and the two sizes agree to within half a cent: the runtime publishes PositionSize.notional_usdt rounded to 2 decimals, so this is a presentation difference and not a policy one

harness.intent_convention: the intent is stated once, at the cost-adjusted price the research entry would actually pay, and the runtime signal's stop_loss_pct is derived from that same price, so a sizing difference is a policy difference and not a rounding convention; the identity is asserted by a unit test, not assumed
harness.research: trading_bot.research.edge01.simulator._enter (the real call the simulator and the WP-EDGE-02 audit used)
harness.shared_authority: config/risk.yaml, read by both sides for every limit

decision.not_claimed: parity between two risk models says nothing about profit; no limit is changed by this comparison and nothing here promotes a strategy
decision.question: Fed identical state and identical intent, do the research budget and the runtime Risk Engine admit, refuse and size the same entry?

tolerances.note: the arithmetic tolerance is 1e-6 USDT; the runtime's published notional is rounded to cents, so a gap at or below half a cent is classified as SIZING_ROUNDING_ONLY and anything larger stays a substantive divergence

verdicts.PARITY_PASS: zero PARITY_DEFECT across the declared cases and every captured shadow decision is reproduced from its own state
